record.context_brief: Existential inclusion into a matrix ultraproduct
record.original_question: Does there exist an existential inclusion of the free group factor L(F_2) into a tracial matrix ultraproduct M_U = ∏_{n→U} M_n(C)?

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Does there exist an existential inclusion of L(F2) into MU?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{F}_2$ denote the free group on two generators and let $L(\mathbb{F}_2)$ be the associated free group factor (the von Neumann algebra generated by the left regular representation of $\mathbb{F}_2$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb{F}_2)$, equipped with its canonical faithful normal tracial state $\tau$). For each $n \geq 1$, let $M_n(\mathbb{C})$ denote the $n \times n$ complex matrices with normalized trace $\mathrm{tr}_n$. Fix a free ultrafilter $\mathcal{U}$ on $\mathbb{N}$, and form the tracial matrix ultraproduct
$$\mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}} = \prod_{n \to \mathcal{U}} M_n(\mathbb{C}),$$
i.e., the quotient of $\ell^\infty(\mathbb{N}, M_n(\mathbb{C}))$ by the ideal of sequences $(x_n)$ with $\lim_{n \to \mathcal{U}} \mathrm{tr}_n(x_n^* x_n) = 0$, viewed as a tracial von Neumann algebra in the language of tracial von Neumann algebras (continuous model theory).

A trace-preserving inclusion $N \hookrightarrow M$ of tracial von Neumann algebras is called \emph{existential} if for every existential formula $\varphi(\bar{x})$ in this language and every tuple $\bar{a}$ from $N$, the value of $\varphi(\bar{a})$ computed in $N$ equals the value computed in $M$.

Question: Does there exist an existential inclusion $L(\mathbb{F}_2) \hookrightarrow \mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}}$?
artifact.category_tag: tracial von Neumann algebras and model theory
artifact.status_search_result: The question of whether the free group factor $L(\mathbb{F}_2)$ admits an existential embedding into a matrix ultraproduct is listed as an open problem in current compilations of open questions on ultraproduct II$_1$ factors. While the broader Connes embedding problem was settled negatively (MIP*=RE), the existence of an existential, as opposed to merely elementary, embedding of $L(\mathbb{F}_2)$ into $\mathcal{M}_{\mathcal{U}}$ remains an open question; no published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: On ultraproduct embeddings and amenability for tracial von Neumann algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies model-theoretic embeddings of tracial von Neumann algebras into ultraproducts, including existential-type properties; the existential embedding question for free group factors is not resolved.
status_evidence.claim: Model-theoretic ultraproduct embeddings of free group factors remain an active topic with the existential variant unresolved.

status_evidence.title: About the Connes embedding conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys CEP and related embedding properties; existential embedding into matrix ultraproducts is a strictly stronger property than mere embedding.
status_evidence.claim: Existential embedding is strictly stronger than embedding and is not known for $L(\mathbb{F}_2)$.
